newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Bahraini for smuggling heroin.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Bahraini for smuggling heroin.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Bahraini man on Monday for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the Saudi interior ministry said.

A statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said Adnan Mohammad Nassrullah Hussein was executed in the eastern city of Dammam after a court found him guilty of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin.
The execution raised to 29 the number of people put to death in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
